run_train_normal: run the TrainNormal class to train a JAX model with cross-entropy loss and weight decay
setup_model_finetune: setup a Haiku model for fine-tuning by partitioning trainable and fixed parameters
compute_loss_error: compute cross-entropy loss with weight decay and error rate for model parameters
test_trained_model: test a trained model on validation and test datasets and log evaluation metrics
get_train_functions: get JIT-compiled loss and update functions for training with an optax optimizer
